g.title: lld
g.text: auth-service — Class diagram (app IdP + reusable auth-client verify SDK)

g.title: cluster_cli
g.text: auth-client SDK (client · com.petstore.auth.client) — imported by every verifier service

g.title: AuthService
g.text: Only password-checker (BCrypt); empty = unknown OR mismatch

g.title: JwtIssuer
g.text: SOLE holder of RSA private key; only signWith() in fleet

g.title: AccountController
g.text: POST /auth/accounts — provision credential; ADMIN token gates non-USER roles

g.title: AccountRepository
g.text: extends JpaRepository<AccountEntity, String> — Spring Data adapter at runtime

g.title: AuthClaims
g.text: Claim-name constants shared by issuer + verifier so they can't drift

g.title: SecurityConfig
g.text: Stateless; login/accounts/actuator permitAll, else denyAll; H2 console only @dev

g.title: AuthJwtFilter
g.text: Verify-only; reads Bearer header OR jwt cookie; populates SecurityContext ROLE_*

g.title: JwtVerifier
g.text: REUSED by warehouse/inventory/storefront/… — public key only, cannot sign

g.title: AuthClient
g.text: Callers reuse instead of hand-rolling HTTP; bounded timeouts

g.title: AuthPublicKey
g.text: Loads petstore-auth-public.pem from classpath — zero-config verifier
